description: Known non-product modules from files.qip. Each is in the Quartus source list but absent from the product map report hierarchy. DEFAULT-RED: any module NOT listed here that is absent from product will FAIL the gate.
note: This gate goes RED by default. Without this file, 36 modules fail. The two defining instances of #19 (h264_intra4x4_pred, h264_intra16x16_pred) are in this list — they would fail without acknowledgement.

findings.reason: bench-only: Simulation-only SVA assertion module. Ifdef SIM_ONLY. Never synthesised.
bench-only: Lookup table used only by testbench (IDCT reference model). Not part of product RTL.
bench-only: Test tone generator for bench audio verification. Not part of product.
bench-only: SDRAM simulation model (behavioural). Product uses real SDRAM chip, not this model.
bench-only: SDRAM power-on memory test. Excluded from product build (not in Plex.qsf file list).
bench-only: Original SDRAM-based frame store. Replaced by ddr_frame_store in product. Retained for SDRAM bench testing.
bench-only: SDRAM-era frame ingester. Replaced by DDR path. Retained for bench testing.
bench-only: DDR frame reader sub-module used only in testbench configurations. Product uses ddr_frame_store directly.
